What to record: One narrow decision or workflow question
Required evidence: Approved study brief and named decision owner
Release gate: Question is specific enough to measure

What to record: Facilities teams transactions or events included
Start and end dates before the intervention
Release gate: Period is long enough to represent the baseline limitation honestly

What to record: System that authoritatively records the measure
Release gate: Dashboard displays are reconciled to the governing source

What to record: Count or amount that forms the top of the measure
Release gate: Definition is stable across baseline and result periods

What to record: Population opportunity or exposure behind the measure
Release gate: Rate is not presented without its denominator

What to record: Exact process training software or property change
Required evidence: Approved change record and implementation timestamp
Release gate: Proposed or partial work is not labeled implemented

What to record: Person or role that approved the intervention
Release gate: Approval and execution are separately evidenced

What to record: Failures exclusions reversals and manual overrides
Release gate: Material adverse and null outcomes are retained

What to record: Before-after matched comparison or other design
Release gate: Causal language matches the design limitation
Result is reproducible and not a model estimate

What to record: Proof the outcome posted or closed in the governing system
Required evidence: Receipt ledger export or final system state
Release gate: Activity is not treated as completion

What to record: Missing duplicate stale or inconsistent records
Permission redaction aggregation and retention rules
Release gate: No tenant payment credential or customer-identifying data is exposed

What to record: Reviewer questions alternative explanations and adverse findings
Release gate: Material criticism is addressed or disclosed

What to record: Operator vendor product funder and contributor relationships
Selection measurement comparison duration and transferability limits
Release gate: No portfolio-wide best or guaranteed claim exceeds the evidence

What to record: Exact public tables figures wording and destination
Release gate: Public URL is released only after final evidence readback
